title: Pet-Incident Surcharge by Days Since the Last Pets Notice — Community Rules & Site Care
content:
A pet-incident surcharge is added to the registration-year fee of a pet under Community Rules & Site Care by the days from the most recent pets-class violation notice on the plan record — the day it was served — to the handling date.

| Days from the most recent pets-class notice to the handling date | Surcharge |
|---|---|
| 60 days or fewer | $20.00 |
| more than 60 days, up to and including 180 days | $10.00 |
| more than 180 days, or no pets-class notice on the record | none |

Only the most recent pets-class notice is measured, in calendar days.

## The thresholds on both sides

| Days | Surcharge |
|---|---|
| 60 | $20.00 |
| 61 | $10.00 |
| 180 | $10.00 |
| 181 | none |

## Hypothetical case

The most recent pets-class notice was served on 10 August and the handling date is 9 October: 60 days, so the surcharge is $20.00. Had that notice been served on 9 August, the count would be 61 days and the surcharge $10.00.
